comparisons.name: production_process_320x240

baseline.label: Std build
baseline.checksum_policy: FNV-style checksum over production quantized map and spreaded quantized map; GradientXY floating angles are covered by tolerant correctness tests
baseline.timer_boundary: processInputData includes RGB copy, Gaussian convolution, post-Gaussian Std/RVV color-gradient chain and spread; excludes feature extraction
baseline.gate: organized PointXYZRGB cloud, width>=3, height>=3, __RVV10__ candidate build dispatches after Gaussian output to pcl::RGB
baseline.mask: production gradient_magnitude_threshold predicate followed by production 3x3 dominant-bin filter and spread mask behavior
baseline.reduction: scalar Gaussian and spread around an RVV post-Gaussian RGB byte stride-load Sobel stencil, max-channel selection, per-lane sqrt/atan2/angle quantize plus lane-wise dominant filter
